title: Mixin @Shadow fields: the type, handled
text: The type `mixin field gone, game: linked` mostly held breaks no update made: every field of a mixin was checked as a @Shadow, so a mixin's own field named like a target field (Distant Horizons' LOGGER, Sodium's cloudRenderer) was reported, and so was a shadow of a field the loader patches (NeoForge's ParticleEngine.providers is a Map, vanilla's an Int2ObjectMap), whose type never matched the vanilla snapshot in either release. Now only a @Shadow whose type matched the old release's field and not the new one's is a break. Such a shadow is the target's field under the mixin's name: each use is ported as a use of that field (the learner's answer for it, or a field report with the learner's evidence) and the declaration is dropped, since Mixin refuses a shadow its target lacks. 'game: linked' on the old type meant no evidence at all.
finish: the type's finishes and mods counts fall across every update, port.jar-links.newest and big-updates no lower, and load on a real server and client where it frees the most
wrongIf: a mod this frees fails in a real game
result: PR #151, tools/cloud-run exposure https://github.com/Noisemaker111/minecraft-modding-tools/actions/runs/44879101068. Type finishes 68 -> 0 and appears in 328 -> 0 mod ports: the real breaks (fields the game removed or retyped, mostly redesigns: Explosion, WeightedBakedModel, MapRenderer) now count under field, game: ..., with the learner's evidence, which answers about 2% of them so far. Every update 5,979 -> 6,044 of 9,423, big updates 1,917 -> 1,924, newest 15 -> 15, no update lower (main's numbers before #149's successors). Real NeoForge 1.21.3 (bench/exposure/load-linked-neoforge-1.21.2-1.21.3.json): 69 of 81 standalone ports load on the server; Sodium, Fusion and Architectury, freed here, load on the server and in the client. pack-check now names a jar the loader refuses as not a mod file and the mod that declares another incompatible.
next: The learner answers few removed private fields; pack-check's blame of every mixin a failing stack carries was fixed in PR #153.
